claims.claim: One person died in a Friday house fire on the 9800 block of Young Road in Chilliwack after crews were called around 2:15 p.m.
claims.episode_span: Crews were called to the 9800 block of the street around 2:15 p.m.
claims.source_title: Blaze kills one in Chilliwack home fire
claims.supporting_quote: Fire crews were called to the 9800 block of the street around 2:15 p.m.

claims.claim: The Chilliwack Fire Department said firefighters located an individual who was pronounced deceased at the scene, other residents could not return Friday night because of fire, smoke and water damage, and the cause remains under investigation.
claims.episode_span: The department said that individual was pronounced deceased at the scene.
claims.source_title: Blaze kills one in Chilliwack home fire
claims.supporting_quote: “The individual was pronounced deceased at the scene.”

claims.claim: Three bystanders rescued a woman from a truck that left the Chahko Mika Mall parking lot and entered Kootenay Lake after 911 calls around 1:18 p.m. Saturday.
claims.episode_span: Nelson Police Department said it received 911 calls around 1:18 p.m. saying a truck had left the parking lot of Chahko Mika Mall and landed in the lake.
claims.source_title: Samaritans rescue truck from Kootenay Lake
claims.supporting_quote: Nelson Police Department says it received 911 calls around 1:18 p.m. saying a truck had left the parking lot of Chahko Mika Mall and landed in the lake.

claims.claim: Paramedics released the driver without a hospital trip, drugs and alcohol were ruled out, and the crash remains under investigation.
claims.episode_span: She was checked by paramedics and released without being taken to hospital.
claims.source_title: Samaritans rescue truck from Kootenay Lake
claims.supporting_quote: She was checked out by paramedics and released without being taken to the hospital.

claims.claim: No further rabid skunks were found in Vancouver; a small number of people received post-exposure care; the tested skunk had the bat variant.
claims.episode_span: The skunk that was tested had tested positive for the bat variant of rabies.
claims.source_title: After Testing, No Further Rabid Skunks Found in Vancouver
claims.supporting_quote: A ‘small number’ of people received post-exposure care. The skunk tested positive for the bat variant.

claims.claim: Incoming premier Lorne Doerkson says his preference is that teleworking public servants return to the office.
claims.episode_span: British Columbia’s incoming premier, Lorne Doerkson, says his preference is to see teleworking public servants return to the office environment.
claims.source_title: Doerkson says 'preference' is for B.C. public servants to return to office work
claims.supporting_quote: British Columbia's incoming premier says his "preference" is to see teleworking public servants return to the office environment.

claims.claim: After western jurisdictions stayed on daylight time, some Canadians reported incorrect phone times; Telus attributed that to phone time-zone updates and advised automatic time zone plus a restart.
claims.episode_span: A statement from Telus says the issue is related to how some phones update their time-zone information, rather than the service provider.
claims.source_title: Parents cheer, businesses brace as Western Canada ditches the time change
claims.supporting_quote: “Customers experiencing this issue can check their phone’s settings to ensure that ‘set time zone automatically’ is selected, then restart their phone to help apply any available time zone updates,” the company says.

claims.claim: Rogers reported no network issues, Air Canada said operations were normal, and Google said teams are pushing time-zone updates to Canadian users.
claims.episode_span: Air Canada said Sunday its operations were normal, noting that all flights use the internationally recognized time standard
claims.source_title: Parents cheer, businesses brace as Western Canada ditches the time change
claims.supporting_quote: In the skies, Air Canada said Sunday its operations were normal, noting that all flights use the internationally recognized time standard and that time changes are managed using established industry data sources.

claims.claim: A B.C. man was acquitted of aggravated assault and uttering threats after a beer-league incident in which a rival was struck in the face with a stick and suffered serious head injuries.
claims.episode_span: A B.C. man has been acquitted of aggravated assault and uttering threats over an incident during a beer-league hockey game
claims.source_title: B.C. beer league hockey player acquitted of assault after rival struck in face with stick
claims.supporting_quote: A B.C. man has been acquitted of aggravated assault and uttering threats over an incident during a beer league hockey game that left another player with serious head injuries.

claims.claim: The Vancouver Symphony plays November 6 and 7 at 7:30 p.m. at the Orpheum with Antony Hermus, Scriabin, Prokofiev’s Cinderella, and Shostakovich’s First Violin Concerto with Kevin Zhu.
claims.episode_span: The month opens with the Vancouver Symphony Orchestra on November 6 and 7 at 7:30 p.m. at the Orpheum.

claims.supporting_quote: The month begins with one of the Vancouver Symphony Orchestra’s more interesting fall concerts, Nov. 6 to 7 at 7:30 p.m. at the Orpheum

claims.claim: Chor Leoni’s 35th Remembrance concert is November 11 at 2 p.m. and 5 p.m. at St. Andrew’s-Wesley, and Jean Rondeau plays November 15 at 3 p.m. at the Barnet Recital Hall.
claims.episode_span: Chor Leoni’s Remembrance Day concert, The Soul Flies Away, is the choir’s 35th annual event of that kind, at 2 p.m. and 5 p.m. on November 11 at St. Andrew’s-Wesley church.
claims.source_title: It's a prime time for classical music in Vancouver. Here's what to see in November
claims.supporting_quote: This year’s concert, The Soul Flies Away, is The Lions’ 35th annual Remembrance Day event. (2 and 5 p.m. at St. Andrew’s-Wesley church, chorleoni.org ).

claims.supporting_quote: Closed. Detour in effect. Watch for traffic control. Expect delays. Eastbound traffic will be shifted to south of the median.
